correctness.summary: Plancherel in the linear graph coordinate reduces the endpoint L4 estimate to a one-dimensional positive Fourier-kernel quadratic form. The critical kernel has |xi|^{-1/k} local singularity and |xi|^{-2} decay. A two-regime Schur bound recovers exactly the source normal gap plus terminal cutoff, and symmetric Schur then yields the stated energy. Endpoint, flat-point, stationary-point, real noninteger k, translation, and L2 approximation issues were checked.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: Vergara's arXiv:2609.20643v1 explicitly leaves iota=(k-1)/k open for the monomial weighted theorem. Repository and external searches did not locate equivalent coverage. Related primary theorem statements on power-curve square functions and phase-space weighted extension do not state this normal-direction-energy endpoint. The main residual risk is an unindexed contemporaneous follow-up because the source is very recent.

value.summary: The result closes an explicit endpoint gap and completes the exact monomial threshold. It also replaces the logarithmically divergent annular summation at criticality by a direct positive-kernel/Schur mechanism whose scale matches the terminal angular cutoff.

limitations: Only the monomial model is settled; the general fixed finite-type endpoint remains open.
The proof uses a global linear graph coordinate and explicit power-law two-point geometry.
No Lorentz-space or weak-type endpoint refinement, stability theorem, or extremizer classification is claimed.
A contemporaneous unindexed overlap may exist because the direct source is very recent.
Independent audit has not been performed.
